title: Abelian Cayley High-Dimensional Expanders with Polylogarithmic Degree
summary: We construct an explicit infinite family of simple two-dimensional Cayley complexes over $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ whose degree is polynomial in $n$ and whose nontrivial vertex-link eigenvalues lie in $[-λ,λ]$ for every fixed $λ>0$. For every fixed $d\ge2$, we also obtain an explicit infinite family of weighted $d$-dimensional Cayley complexes over $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ with codimension-two local spectral norm at most $1/d$ and Cayley degree $Θ_d(n)$.
